name: Godot 4.6 (web export)
describe: Godot 4.6's web export as a full runtime: the game is a Godot project (scenes, GDScript, Godot's own 2D physics and drawing); the shared system (slots, the round and the friends, the menu, HUD and wallet, sounds, the observation) runs in the page and meets it through JavaScriptBridge once a frame.
for: 2D games (pixel and drawn: side-on stages and fields seen from above, from a gf-tilemap-1 map, gf-flat-1 bodies and pictures) and 3D arenas with gf-humanoid-1 bodies
says: WebGL2 compatibility rendering, one thread (no cross-origin isolation); a 37.7 MB engine file (about 9 MB compressed) on first load; 2D side-on and top-down, 3D with a follow camera; tested in headless Chrome and Firefox on a desktop and a phone emulated in Chrome, never a real phone, not Safari

evidence.what: run 6, verify --release on every Godot example on the pixel kind's new art (the field from three's draw plan, the seat colour on the shirt only): 68-72 checks each, all passed, the shared multiplayer gate 24/24 each
evidence.browser: headless Chrome (Playwright) on Linux, ANGLE on the GL/EGL driver, a desktop GPU

evidence.what: run 5, verify --release on every Godot example with the phone layout: 68-72 checks each, all passed, the shared multiplayer gate 24/24 each; the phone leg held upright and sideways
evidence.browser: headless Chrome (Playwright) on Linux, ANGLE on the GL/EGL driver, a desktop GPU

evidence.what: verify --release on every Godot example (side-on, top-down, 3D, the Coin Hop showcase candidate): the six gates with the measures this runtime supplies, the shared multiplayer gate, a phone emulated in Chrome, Firefox
evidence.browser: headless Chrome (Playwright) on Linux, ANGLE on the GL/EGL driver, a desktop GPU

evidence.what: run 1 (staging): minimal 33/33, Coin Hop 34/34, mp gate 24/24

pins.name: Godot editor
pins.note: linux x86-64 binary; the archive is pinned too (toolchain/toolchain.json)

pins.name: Godot web template (web_nothreads_release.zip)
pins.note: its godot.js and godot.wasm are every game's build/game.js and build/game.wasm, byte for byte (verify measure 2)

play.rules: GDScript in the game's Godot project (project/main.gd and its scenes) through the GF autoload; the round's rules in rules.js (ctx), which hears every GF.event
play.loops: the shared session's round loop in the page; Godot keeps running its own frame beside it

worlds.describe: a side-on stage from a gf-tilemap-1 map (ground, walls, one-way ledges, spawns, marks)
a field seen from above from a gf-tilemap-1 map (a base kind, walls, water, paths, spawns, marks); generated from the title when the spec draws none
the same kind of map built in 3D: the base kind is the ground, walls stand 2 m, water is a basin

create.how: gamesfun create (runtimes/godot/gamesfun.mjs → tools/create.mjs; the adapter create.mjs): spec v2 → config, slots, the Godot project from the starter the camera picks (2d-side, 2d-top, 3d-follow), the export; refuses only a camera, world or multiplayer mode it cannot boot

slots.how: every picture, model and value is a slot read at run time through gf-assets (GF.texture, GF.bytes, GF.value): Studio's replaced picture and a live value change both show without a new export (verify measure 8, 2D and 3D)
gaps: no slot-ID pass over what Godot draws: that nothing on screen comes from outside a slot is not proven (measure 4's second half)

multiplayer.how: gf/mp live: each copy sends its pose, Godot draws every friend where they are, in their seat colour with the page's name tag; the host owns the round, scores and ctx.shared (GF.shared); the friends page's lobby and names; Go live from the pause menu (a viewer follows the streamer with no player of its own) and voice through gf/mp (measure 34); bots alone (GfBots2D, GfBots3D)
gaps: renaming in the waiting room not measured on godot

hostBridge.how: the kit's menu, HUD, pause menu, results and panels (GF.panel: choice, shop, inventory, dialogue, input) over Godot's canvas; Esc and Enter read by the page; while the kit holds input GF empties the game's input map, and alone the pause menu pauses the scene tree; touch: the kit's stick and buttons press the game's actions
gaps: the wallet's loadouts are not drawn on Godot bodies, and gf/web3 is not added to a Godot game

observation.how: window.__game answers every name of runtimes/CONTRACT.md §6.1 and the snapshot's fields (2D and 3D: project() through the game's camera), panels() the shared panels, the game's own block under godot (frames, view, friends, the files it read, its script errors, its own observe, the last panel answer)
gaps: coverage() and sight() answer notYet (no slot-ID pass)
no stepped time (measures 35 and 38 run in real time)

measures.how: tools/verify.mjs: gates A to F with the measures below, verdict in builder/gates/verdict.schema.json; the shared multiplayer gate with --mp-gate
gaps: skipped measures are listed with why under measures.skipped

examples.how: examples/minimal/godot-ledge-friends (side), godot-meadow-walk (top), godot-arena-friends (3D), each create's output from its spec; examples/showcase/godot-coin-hop (a coin grab, host-owned coins, bots that hunt coins, its own two-player test)
gaps: the showcase has no reference game named by the creator and no person has played it

pinned.how: the editor and the web template by sha256 (toolchain/toolchain.json); every game's engine files held to the template's bytes and its project to its export (measure 2); Godot's licence and third-party notices beside the engine in every game

toolchainOnDemand.how: tools/install.mjs runs only from create, export, dev and verify of a godot game; it takes the editor (71 MB archive) and pulls the 9.6 MB template out of Godot's 1.25 GB archive by HTTP range requests, each checked by sha256; a 3D Godot game also installs the 3D tools' packages once (gltf-transform, meshoptimizer) to decode its body and clips
